frequently_asked_questions.question: What is the NAAC accreditation of GGU?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Godavari Global University (GGU) is accredited with the highest NAAC A++ Grade, reflecting superior academic standards, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and strong placement outcomes.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How large is the GGU campus?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: GGU features a massive, vibrant 300-acre green campus located in Chaitanya Knowledge City along NH-16 in Rajahmundry (Rajamahendravaram), Andhra Pradesh.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Does GGU offer engineering degrees in CSE with AI & ML or Data Science?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! The School of Engineering & Technology offers specialized 4-year B.Tech programs in CSE with AI & ML, Data Science, and Cyber Security, alongside traditional CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, Mining, and Automobile Engineering.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How are the hostel and mess facilities at GGU?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: GGU has separate on-campus hostels for boys and girls with AC and Non-AC options, 24/7 Wi-Fi, RO water, solar hot water, 24/7 medical care, strict security, and hygienic multi-cuisine dining serving quality North and South Indian food.

frequently_asked_questions.question: What companies visit GGU for placements?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Over 2,000+ offers are bagged annually from top recruiters including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini, Tech Mahindra, Amazon, Virtusa, HCL, and L&T, with highest packages reaching ₹25+ LPA.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can I get help with engineering subjects or project work?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! As the GGU AI Assistant, I can explain engineering concepts (DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Data Structures, AI/ML, VLSI, CAD, etc.), debug code, and analyze uploaded course documents and PDFs.
